scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w @chippy/web" "npm run dev -w @chippy/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @chippy/shared && npm run build -w @chippy/api && npm run build -w @chippy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @chippy/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
